comment: Apple Music already gives you lossless and Spatial Audio in the same plan, so Spotify going up to $10.99 with the same lossy audio is a hard sell. I keep Spotify for Connect and Android Auto but I am looking hard at switching.

Honestly the library and Discover Weekly are still why I am here, and Premium was already cheap for what you get. A few bucks more does not change much for me, though I wish the recommendations stopped repeating my own songs.
Family went up a buck, so split across the household it is still pennies per person. Annoying but it works great for us and we are not going back to ads.

Ten bucks already felt like a lot just to remove ads, and now it is eleven while the free tier keeps getting more ads. It is still good bang for the buck for the catalog, but I want to see the free tier stop getting worse at the same time.
Great, paying more for an app where the UI is a mess every other month and the recommendations are stale. If the next redesign makes it worse I am going to YouTube Music and not looking back.
Raising the price while the playlist tools still cannot handle duplicates or show liked songs is wild. Fix the sorting stuff first, then charge me more.
THEY RAISE THE PRICE AND STILL CAN'T SHOW ME MY LIKED TRACKS IN PLAYLISTS. I am seriously going back to Apple Music, I already miss adding a song to several playlists at once being easy there.
Don't care about the price, I cancelled already. I just want the renewal pop-up to stop showing up every time I open the app, clearing cache did nothing. Anyone have a fix that actually works?
Spotify raises the price and the artists still get fractions of a cent per stream. Where is the extra money going, because it is not going to the people making the music.
Cool, more money for a product that keeps taking features away. My liked songs still do not show up on album track lists, so I will unsubscribe again if that does not come back.
Price bump is annoying but nothing else matches the radio and the catalog right now. I just wish they showed exact play counts and stopped filling radio with songs I already know.
A buck more for ad-free, offline, and casting is still a steal compared with my other subscriptions combined. The free tier is still unusable so I will keep paying.
Raising the price on an app that still breaks offline downloads after every update? I have reinstalled three times and an older version is the only one that worked. Not paying more until it works.
Student plan going from $4.99 to $5.99 hurts, I'm on a tight budget. If it keeps going up I'm going back to Apple Music, even though I'll miss the Hulu bundle.
Still no lossless tier and now they want more money for it. Tidal already has hi-fi and Apple Music has lossless, so Spotify charging more while skipping the audio quality is really frustrating.
More money and shuffle still plays the same 50 songs out of my giant playlists. I pay to avoid random adds, but if I cannot get a true random shuffle I am moving to Apple Music.
I already cancelled my family plan over the podcast-stuffed home screen, so this price hike changes nothing for me. Show me the music and I would come back.
Price goes up and the home screen is still a TikTok feed with two cards on screen. This is garbage and I'm done, bring back the old UI or I'm gone for good.
Another dollar a month when I am already having a hard time paying some months. Premium is still cheap, but I will probably drop back to free until money is steadier.
Price going up while features still disappear and come back with no explanation. Still being tested, maybe, but vote with your wallet until they bring back what we had.
Spotify wants more money and still has no lossless, while Tidal pays artists better and sounds way better. I will keep Spotify for Connect and recs but the HiFi tier would be worth it, not this.
Paying more and I still hear ads in podcasts? They keep shoving podcasts down my throat too. I might just go to YouTube Premium or stick to Overcast and drop the music side.
Absolutely hate this update and now the price goes up too. If the music tab keeps the feed layout I'm switching to Apple Music, my playlists are a pain to find already.
I already cancelled and uninstalled after the last forced update, so the price does not matter to me. Keep the old version and the classic interface and I'll come back.
I'm on free so the price bump does not touch me, but I'd only pay again if the ads and random shuffle go away. Tempted but not yet.
Ten bucks for the full catalog was already an incredible deal and they should charge more given what artists get paid. Honestly a long overdue increase, and I'm still paying.
